absorption: The local client moves to another transport with the same identity isolation and live tool proof, or upstream provides an equivalent stdio deployment surface.

consumers.name: Standalone Codex clients configured for the local Honcho MCP.

contract: Standalone Codex can connect through a local stdio MCP wrapper with its own fixed workspace/peer identity, independent of the public ChatGPT OAuth identity boundary.
Host-side JWT helpers mint scoped MCP credentials with raw or environment output; README documents the outside-container stdio setup and CLI usage.

fork: Run tests/test_generate_jwt_script.py and inspect mint_api_key delegation to generate_jwt.
proof.fork_expected: Node typecheck passes and the private stdio smoke returns server instructions/tool inventory under the intended Codex identity.
upstream: inspect the MCP entrypoints on the recorded upstream base.
proof.upstream_expected: no local stdio wrapper with the fork's separate Codex identity exists.

upstream_gap: The recorded upstream base has no local stdio entrypoint/wrapper carrying the separate Codex identity convention.
The recorded upstream lacks the fork MCP JWT helper presets, output modes and mint_api_key wrapper.
